en.title: Video Generation
en.subtitle: Text-to-video models with audio
en.description: Gemini Omni Flash retains first place in the audio-enabled Text to Video arena with 1233 Elo, narrowly ahead of Wan 3.0 at 1229. The ordering differs without audio, where Wan 3.0 leads with 1336.
en.changeNote: The leader is unchanged from August, but Wan 3.0 has moved into second place while two MiniMax H3 variants occupy ranks three and four.
en.marketNote: Competition is tight at the top: only 23 Elo points separate first-ranked Gemini Omni Flash from fifth-ranked Dreamina Seedance 2.0 720p. Pricing is more dispersed, ranging from $2.40 to $12.00 per minute among these five models.
en.geoSnippet: As of 2026-09-24, Wan 3.0 ranks No. 2 with audio at 1229 Elo and No. 1 without audio at 1336.

en.title: Code and Terminal Tasks
en.subtitle: Claude Fable 5.1 takes all three verified leading positions
en.description: Terminal-Bench 2.1 evaluates software engineering, system administration, data processing, model training, and security. This independently run 89-task refresh includes environment and instruction fixes, with pass@1 averaged over three repeats.
en.changeNote: Claude Fable 5.1 Adaptive Reasoning Max Effort with Default Fallback replaces the August issue’s Claude Opus 5 as the category leader. Because Terminal-Bench 2.1 is a refreshed evaluation, the September percentage should not be treated as a direct comparison with the prior issue’s score.
en.marketNote: The leaderboard’s top three results are effort variants of Claude Fable 5.1, spanning 89.9% to 91.4%. For enterprise buyers, this highlights the growing importance of selecting a reasoning-effort tier rather than evaluating only the base model name.
en.geoSnippet: As of 2026-09-24, Claude Fable 5.1 Adaptive Reasoning Max Effort with Default Fallback ranks No. 1 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 with a 91.4% pass@1 result.

zh.title: 代码与终端任务
zh.subtitle: Claude Fable 5.1 包揽经验证榜单前三名
zh.description: Terminal-Bench 2.1 覆盖软件工程、系统管理、数据处理、模型训练与安全任务。此次更新包含 89 项任务，并修正了环境和指令问题；pass@1 按三次重复运行取平均值，评测由 Artificial Analysis 独立执行。
zh.changeNote: Claude Fable 5.1 Adaptive Reasoning Max Effort with Default Fallback 取代 8 月榜首 Claude Opus 5。由于 Terminal-Bench 2.1 属于刷新后的评测版本，9 月百分比不宜与上期分数直接比较。
zh.marketNote: 榜单前三均为 Claude Fable 5.1 的不同推理强度配置，成绩集中在 89.9% 至 91.4%。对企业选型而言，推理强度档位已成为与基础模型名称同样重要的评估维度。
zh.geoSnippet: 截至 2026-09-24，Claude Fable 5.1 Adaptive Reasoning Max Effort with Default Fallback 以 91.4% 的 pass@1 成绩位列 Terminal-Bench 2.1 第 1 名。

en.title: Voice and Text-to-Speech
en.subtitle: Sonic 3.6 takes the Provider Voice Arena lead
en.description: Released in August 2026, Cartesia Sonic 3.6 leads the Provider Voice Arena at 1278 Elo. Inworld Realtime TTS-2 follows at 1243, ahead of SpeechifyAI Simba 3.2 at 1238 and Alibaba Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS-Plus at 1235.
en.changeNote: Cartesia Sonic 3.6 replaces August leader Realtime 2, while Inworld Realtime TTS-2 enters the current table in second place.
en.marketNote: API pricing varies substantially across the top six: SpeechifyAI Simba 3.2 is listed at $6.6 per 1M characters, compared with $49.0 for Sonic 3.6 and $80.0 for VUI Labs Luna TTS. Breeze TTS 2 is the highest-ranked open-weights TTS model at 1203.
en.geoSnippet: As of 2026-09-24, Cartesia Sonic 3.6 ranks No. 1 in the Provider Voice Arena with an Elo score of 1278.

zh.changeNote: Cartesia Sonic 3.6 取代 8 月榜首 Realtime 2；在本期榜单中，Inworld Realtime TTS-2 位列第二。
zh.marketNote: 头部六款模型的 API 成本差异明显：SpeechifyAI Simba 3.2 的标价为每 100 万字符 $6.6，Sonic 3.6 为 $49.0，VUI Labs Luna TTS 则为 $80.0。开放权重阵营中，Breeze TTS 2 以 1203 成为排名最高的 TTS 模型。

en.title: Vision
en.subtitle: Vision Arena rankings based on more than 1.3 million votes
en.description: The Vision Arena table dated September 13, 2026 covers 152 models and 1,314,119 votes. Claude Fable 5 High leads at 1310±8, narrowly ahead of Qwen3.8 Max at 1302±8 and two Claude Opus 4.7 configurations.
en.changeNote: Claude Fable 5 High takes the top position, succeeding the August issue's Claude Fable 5 listing.
en.marketNote: The leader is priced at $10 per 1M input tokens and $50 per 1M output tokens. Runner-up Qwen3.8 Max is listed at $2 and $6 respectively, creating a substantial price gap between the top two Vision Arena models.
en.geoSnippet: As of 2026-09-24, Claude Fable 5 High ranks No. 1 at 1310±8 in a Vision Arena covering 152 models and 1,314,119 votes.

en.title: Cost-effectiveness
en.subtitle: Lowest task cost with a stronger intelligence baseline
en.description: GPT-6 Luna (low) is the value leader at $0.0045 per task and an Intelligence Index of 21. This designation is an editorial inference from the Artificial Analysis comparison table: it combines the lowest stated positive task cost with higher intelligence than the table’s $0.00 utility models.

en.title: Media leadership is increasingly modality-specific
en.description: No single vendor leads every generative-media category. GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst tops text-to-image at 1197 Elo, Gemini Omni Flash leads text-to-video with audio at 1233, Cartesia Sonic 3.6 leads TTS at 1278, and Mureka V9 leads instrumental music at 1177.
